violations.text: Spray bottle Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. The solution was adjusted to the proper mixture of 50-100ppm at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Working spray bottle containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Chemical names were added to spray bottles at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The wood mounting block to the kitchen hand sink is unfinished/unsealed wood. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. Wood mounting block is to be sealed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/25/2026

Various items were observed held at 46-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Foods were stored on top of covered pans/over fill line of food in the flip top prep unit overnight. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of items at the time of inspection. Foods to not be stored overfill line in flip top prep unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of biofilm. Non-food contact surfaces to be cleaned as often as necessary. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2024
